events.title: French settlement and the partition
hints: French and Dutch survivors of a Spanish occupation agreed to share a small island in 1648.
Plantations and salt pans used enslaved labour for two centuries.
Slavery on this side ended in 1848.
events.summary: France and the Dutch Republic divided the island in 1648 under the Treaty of Concordia. The French side developed plantations and salt-working based on enslaved labour. Slavery was abolished by France in 1848.
